semantic_inputs: own current r145 MANIFEST.json text and exact Git identity

milestone.name: readable manifest to opaque artifact identity bridge
milestone.revision: The current readable role-local manifest declares payload_path=payload.bin and payload_blob_sha=0b7cb3e9...; resolving that path and reading only its Git blob SHA matched exactly. Mutated declared SHA, wrong existing relative path, missing path (live 404), and unsafe ../ path all reject. This lets scheduled Chat use a readable proof-carrying manifest to bind an opaque binary identity without rebuilding or depending on byte-faithful binary content readback.

manifest_binding.scope: own role-local readable manifest authority + one opaque Git blob identity

external_manifest_authenticity.reason: r150 authority comes from own repository boundary; arbitrary external unsigned manifests are not authenticated

negative_evidence: A manifest can bridge readable metadata to opaque identity but cannot prove binary semantics.
Path resolution must be bounded/fail-closed; wrong and missing paths cannot silently fall back.
External manifest authenticity is a separate problem from manifest-to-subject identity binding.

frontier.action: Audit provider-reported signature verification as a read-only authenticity premise for already-signed repository commits. Test one current role-produced commit and one public signed commit; require exact commit SHA and verified=true. Do not attempt signing or local cryptographic verification.
If a signed-commit positive exists, bind one file blob identity at that exact commit and classify it as provider-asserted signed-tree evidence, not independently verified cryptography.
Keep raw Sigstore/in-toto bundles unresolved unless an actual zero-executor verifier surface exists.

exact_next_action: Use GitHub's documented commit verification object only as read-only evidence. Probe a role-local connector-created commit and a public commit known to expose verification metadata. Accept a narrow external premise only if verification.verified=true at an exact immutable commit SHA; then fetch one file at that exact ref and record its blob SHA. Reject unsigned commits and mutable-branch-only references. Do not use commit-message semantics, raw signature bytes, Cosign, Actions or hosted verification jobs.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint; global completion false; frontier nonempty
